Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the temporal context of the user's query. While the Planner correctly identified that the 58th quadrennial election was the 2016 election (based on WebSurfer's data), it erroneously concluded that the election "held after" the 2016 Michigan Democratic primary was the 2020 election. The phrase "held after" in this context refers to the specific election cycle that occurred subsequent to the primary event within the same quadrennial cycle (i.e., the November 2016 general election), not the next quadrennial cycle (2020). The Planner failed to distinguish between "the next election in the sequence of events" (Nov 2016) and "the next quadrennial election" (Nov 2020), leading to a premature and incorrect task completion.
